definitions: An exclamation of exasperation or resignation when something unfortunate or undesirable happens, often implying that such bad fortune is typical for the speaker.
Used to express ironic or sarcastic acceptance of a negative outcome, suggesting it was predictable given one's usual bad luck.
examples: Just my luck, I missed the bus again.
The one day I forget my umbrella, just my luck, it rains.
Just my luck, the store closed five minutes before I got there.
